rules: Speak to one person: 'you', 'your goals', 'whenever it suits you'.
Lead with the benefit, then the detail. 'Train whenever it suits your schedule' before opening hours.
Sentence case for headings. One phrase in the heading carries the green emphasis, never the whole line.
UPPERCASE for navigation items, buttons, tabs and section labels only.
Australian English: colour, programme is not used, 'centre', 'organise'.
Short paragraphs. Lists use the outlined circle-tick, never plain bullets.
Exclamation marks are rare and earned. One per page at most.
voice.headlinePattern: White heading with a single green-emphasised phrase. Examples: 'Meet ONYX <green>Coaches</green>', 'Biggest <green>24/7 Gym</green> in Alexandria', 'Not only a gym, but also a <green>community.</green>'

contrastRules: Green on black and white on black pass AA and AAA for body text. Both are the workhorses.
Amber on black passes AA for body text. Use it for labels and buttons, not paragraphs.

White on green (1.9:1) and white on amber (1.7:1) fail AA at every size. The site uses both on its marketing pages. The portal does not: text on a green or amber fill is set in Ink (#0A0A0A), which passes at 11:1 and 12:1. Large display headings on the green bio panel are the one place white on green survives, and only above 32px bold.
Muted grey on black passes AA for body text and is the ceiling for secondary text; nothing dimmer.

rules: Marketing pages centre their text. The portal left-aligns body copy and lists; centred text is kept for hero blocks and empty states.
Headings never exceed two lines on a phone. Cut words, not size.
Numerals in pricing and stats use the price style in green.
Outlined display numerals (03, 04) are Poppins Bold at 120px+, 2px grey stroke, transparent fill, sitting behind or beside a photo.

shape.note: The brand is square-cornered. Buttons, cards, tabs, inputs and frames all sit at 0 radius. The only circles are avatars, the circle-tick icon and the play button.
shape.frame: Feature cards are framed by a 2px green line with a deliberate gap at the top where the green label tab sits over the frame edge.
shape.shadow: None. Depth comes from black on black tone steps and green lines, never from drop shadows.
shape.dim: Hero photography sits under a 60 to 70% black overlay so white and green type stay legible.

imagery.style: Real coaches and members, photographed in the gym. Black ONYX tees. Dark interiors with green structural accents on pillars and walls.
imagery.portraits: Arms crossed, straight to camera, grey brick wall with a diagonal green stripe behind. Cropped to a circle for cards, square for bios.
imagery.treatment: Heroes are dimmed 60 to 70% black. Never bright, never washed out. No stock imagery.
imagery.portalGuidance: Onboarding content uses the client's own photos of the real space: reception, gym floor, RECOVER rooms, class studio. A screenshot-heavy simulation sits on a plain black canvas, no photo behind it.

notes: Text on any green or amber fill is Ink, not white. This is the one deliberate departure from the marketing site and it is for legibility.
Cards are 0 radius with a 1px hairline border, upgrading to 2px green when active or selected.
The gem mark is the favicon and the app icon on a black square.
